subject: general
question:
For the following reaction, balance the chemical equation with state symbols.

CO₂ + H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ + 6H₂O
solution:
The correct answer is '**6CO₂(g) + 12H₂O(I) → C₆H₁₂O₆(aq) + 6O₂(g)+ 6H₂​O(I)'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Balance the carbon atom.
 
 
• 6CO₂ + H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + O₂
 
 
 
• Balance the hydrogen atom.
 
 
• 6CO₂ + 12H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + O₂ + 6H2O
 
 
 
• Balance the oxygen atom.
 
 
• 6CO₂ + 12H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ + 6H2O
 
 
 
• Therefore, the balance chemical equation is: 
 
 
• 6CO2(g) + 12H2O(I) → C₆H12O6(aq) + 6O2(g)+ 6H2​O(I)
